comparison.objective: Place wet-chemical and CO2 extinguishers beside their corresponding hazards.
comparison.physical_skill: Read type cards and carry two large objects to semantic destinations.
comparison.success_condition: Each named extinguisher stands on the correct mark; placement tolerances and failure details are not supplied.
comparison.reason: Tests semantic identification and gross placement rather than coaxial small-tool alignment, bimanual striking, or loose-fragment recovery.
